pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASS: COLLECTIVE NOUNS/ REFLEXIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you emphasise that you did something on your own?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts
2. use collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly
   In simple words: practise until you can use collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.
4. Show that you can: identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences using collective nouns and reflexive pronouns,
2. Collaboration is enhanced as the learner works with peers to pick out collective nouns and reflexive pronouns from a text.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you emphasise that you did something on your own?
2. Which words do you use to refer to a group of things or animals?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts
2. use collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
